findings.issue: `clockwiseAfter(open, toAct === seat ? seat : toAct - 1)` uses `toAct - 1` to make the search start at toAct inclusive. The ternary is redundant, and the off-by-one trick is hard to read.
findings.evidence: clockwiseAfter returns seats starting at the first seat > from. When toAct === seat, the leaver is folded and so not in `open`, so `seat - 1` and `seat` give the same ring. The inclusive start depends on `toAct - 1` (0 for seat 1, which still works because start <= 0 returns the whole list), and the code has no comment explaining it.
findings.fix: Write `clockwiseAfter(open, toAct - 1)` with a short comment saying it starts at toAct inclusive (the leaver is not in `open`), or name it, e.g. `const fromToAct = clockwiseAfter(open, toAct - 1)`.

findings.issue: `sole` does not depend on the award or the winner, yet it is recomputed inside the inner winners loop.
findings.evidence: `const sole = state.result?.endedBy === 'fold' && state.players.filter((q) => !q.folded).length === 1;` sits inside `for (const { seat } of award.winners)`.
findings.fix: Compute `sole` once, before the awards loop.

findings.issue: R2 says the live top at a fold uses seats with 'no fold record anywhere in the hand'. Both walks (hand.ts liveLevels and invariants.ts countedBets) use seats not yet folded at that record instead.
findings.evidence: The `folded` set grows as the walk goes. At the moment forceFold runs, this equals R1's live top, so the implementation is the consistent reading, and the property test with several forced folds per hand passes. The difference is only in the spec text.
findings.fix: No code change. Optionally note in the liveLevels doc comment that 'live' means not folded at that point (this is already implied by 'not yet folded').

summary: All SPEC items are implemented as specified. forceFold voids a strict top bet down to the live top (BB floor preflop), lowers currentBet and betCount, recomputes hasActed and resumes toAct correctly. gather never refunds a folded seat. The checker independently restates R2/R6, and C5 and pot structure now come from the last street. P5 allows a $0 sole survivor. E1-E7 are asserted on exact values, and the 2,000-hand property test asserts every invariant plus at least 200 top-bet voids. The e2e edit only adds a reply wait and a second runFor(1000) before the unchanged assertions (nothing loosened). The advice worker replies exactly once per request, so replies >= posts is a sound settle condition. Verified locally: the four engine test files pass, and the Cancel-resumes e2e passes in chromium and webkit. The SPEC-08 manual mutation check was not run (read-only review). Only MINOR/NIT findings.
